prose.subject: Quick reminder: Invoice INV-98769
prose.body:
Hi Bramblecote Studio team,

Hope you're having a great week! Just a friendly nudge that invoice INV-98769 for 1738.14 USDC is currently due. We wanted to make sure it didn't slip through the cracks.

You can send the payment to our standard vendor wallet: 0x6ac85fe119f566a5927d19c5bdc1a29aa3b91ffe. As always, please include the invoice number in the transaction memo for quick reconciliation on our end.

If you've already sent this, please ignore this email. If you have any questions or need an updated payment link, just reply here or reach out to your account manager. Thanks so much for your prompt attention!

Best regards,
Larchmont Cloud Billing Team
